mechanism: Prefix frequency measurement produces exact Schmidt weights proportional to products of complementary half-syndrome counts. Native collision moments and Born size bias bound average purity at balanced middle scales.
falsifiers: An actual native prefix projector has a Schmidt spectrum different from its complementary syndrome-count products.
The exact IID low-label census contradicts the uniform-target variance, disjoint-half collision product or true Born averaging.
A mean fixed-cut rank-chi full-state approximation violates the Cauchy-Schwarz fidelity/purity bound under the stated source law.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review source-weighted size bias, collision independence and the mean fidelity argument; finite cases alone do not prove the population theorem.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Do not promote this to quantum hardness, a bound on arbitrary tensor geometries, label-adaptive partitions, sieve-retained label laws or observable-specific approximations.
proof_obligations.PO-ALTERNATIVE: Investigate carry/stabilizer descriptions or observable-only contractions that may survive large explicit Schmidt rank.
proof_obligations.PO-SECRET-SIGNAL: Prefix outcome probabilities are independent of the secret and exactly classically samplable. A useful readout must retain and access additional phase information; high entanglement alone is not an advantage.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: Novelty and significance have not been established. This is a scoped research representation audit.
